review_title: Scientific Review & Operation-Registration Handoff for Package 157 R4 Adaptive Continuation

predecessor_terminal_evidence.failure_cause: Step 2 attempted a single 50 nm forward displacement increment (from 0.00185031 to 0.00190031 mm) on a highly refined crack-tip mesh (h = 1.25 um, l0 = 7.5 um). Crack propagation initiated, producing a 143.14 MPa surge in history strain energy. The alternate-minimization contraction rate degenerated to rho_H ~ 0.98, requiring >900 iterations to reach 1e-6 MPa. Outer 100 budget was exhausted.

critical_boundary_displacement_resolutio.convention_clarification: In all continuation decks, N_TOP nodes are tied via *EQUATION to N_RP (node 999999) with 1.0 * uy(top) - 1.0 * uy(RP) = 0. There is ZERO physical offset between RP and top boundary nodes. The initial donor state (Frame 77) was at uy = 0.001800312544 mm. Package 154 Step 1 advanced the top boundary by +50 nm to uy = 0.001850312544 mm and CONVERGED in 74 outers. The accepted Step 1 checkpoint is therefore at uy = 0.001850312544 mm. The failed Step 2 was advancing from 0.001850312544 to 0.001900312544 mm (a 50 nm span). The R4 recovery schedule MUST start from 0.001850312544 mm and advance in positive increments (e.g. +10 nm or +25 nm), reaching 0.001900312544 mm without any backward retraction or unrequested offset.

step1_checkpoint_verification.state_recoverability: Nodal displacements u and damage d are stored for all 7,265 nodes. Full integration-point history H(e, g) across all 28,420 Gauss points is exactly reconstructible from nodal u and mesh coordinates using driving_history(mesh, u, H0) without loss or distortion.

recommended_primary_schedule.description: 5 x 10 nm adaptive sub-steps spanning the failed 50 nm increment

alternative_schedule.description: 2 x 25 nm sub-steps spanning the failed 50 nm increment

execution_registration_decision.required_next_step: In the next controller dispatch, register operation execute_mode1_package157_c1_2_r4_adaptive_continuation under task_type QUALIFIED_EXECUTION, construct Package 157, run authentic Abaqus 2023 compute-node datachecks, verify notification integration, and submit via scripts/hpc/Invoke-Mode1Execution.ps1 with once-only accounting.
